findings: WHAT WITHOUT SO WHAT 1/1 spec sentences never say what the number does for the viewer. "2nm chip" is information; "faster without draining the battery" is relevance. (framework S7)

OPENING has no version, date or time anchor: "Uber's own CTO says that this year he spent twelve hundred dolla". A hook without context is confusion — the viewer should know WHICH thing and WHEN before the claim lands. (framework S1, S16)
NUMBERS: one every 17.0 sentences. The playbook asks for one every 2-3 — concrete numbers are what make a claim feel reported rather than asserted.
